[color=#ffffff]This Greenhouse is large but not ridiculously huge. It has planned spots for [u]82 trees[/u] and crop plots for [u]42 iridium sprinklers[/u]. It also has a mud spa for relaxing and getting that stamina back. If you climb the ladder in the tree room you'll find yourself in a tree house complete with pool table, sofa and radio jukebox! You might want to check out that strange crystal behind the pool table! 

Plenty of ponds and water features give convenient access to refill your watering can.

Now includes a NEW secret garden area with wishing well!!  New attic area for your machines as well!!
[/color]
[color=#ff0000]New dependency[/color] so make sure you have them all downloaded. [/b][/size][/color]

Downloads.Description: Download, unzip and place Stylish Greenhouse folder into your Stardew Valley mods folder. This version changes the look and colors of some items so if you prefer the older style you can keep the older file. Now has an update key.
